correctness.rationale: The exact oriented-gradient generator is directly derived from the symmetric vertex conductance Laplacian; it preserves the zero-sum gradient hyperplane. The Lipschitz cube slice has exactly six extreme gradients, whose images under a two-mode hyperbolic evolution and one decoupled \(e^{-2t}\) mode are explicitly calculated. Positive comparisons distinguish all norming edges and give the full equality faces for all r>0 and t>0. Coefficientwise Taylor comparison proves the branch signs. Analytic derivative sign counting proves the exact \(r=3\) growth threshold and uniqueness of the amplification peak, and a singular asymptotic witness proves the unattained \(3/2\) envelope. A standalone verifier checks exact rational generator identities and independent stochastic-uniformization dual norms on forty rational parameter-time pairs; these finite checks are not substituted for the continuum proof.

value.rationale: A four-cycle is the first simple cycle beyond complete-graph oscillation contraction, and a single edge conductance defect is a canonical controlled perturbation. The exact sharp all-time norm changes its maximizing-edge location as r passes 1, its equality set collapses from a full segment to two specific ramps, and it acquires transient enlargement exactly at \(r>3\). The sharp \(3/2\) envelope as r becomes large exposes a nontrivial conductance–metric mismatch. These are motivated structural boundaries rather than a routine numerical evaluation.
